name: Example: Titan with two weapon-set modes
notes: Demonstrates weapon-set points — the two-mode pattern. Set 1 is the damage mode: a slow two-handed greathammer where attack speed is wasted, so its set-tagged nodes buy raw damage for Earthquake. Set 2 is the defence mode: club + tower shield with Raise Shield bound to it, and its set-tagged nodes buy block/armour that would be dead weight while swinging the two-hander. Set points are a separate quest-earned pool (24 at Lv 64+), so tagged nodes are nearly free — but they're only ACTIVE while their weapon set is equipped.
